title: Master Guide to Central Government Flagship Schemes for Banking Exams

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
schemes.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Finance (Department of Financial Services)
schemes.eligibility: Any individual aged 10 years and above
key_features: Zero-balance Basic Savings Bank Deposit Account (BSBDA) with no minimum balance maintenance charges
Free RuPay Debit Card with inbuilt Accidental Insurance Cover of ₹2 Lakh (for accounts opened after 28.08.2018; ₹1 Lakh earlier)
Overdraft (OD) facility up to ₹10,000 (no conditions for OD up to ₹2,000; upper age limit 65 years)
Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) linkage for Jan Suraksha, PM-KISAN, and LPG subsidies
schemes.exam_relevance: Top Priority. Invariably tested on OD limit (₹10,000) and RuPay accident insurance (₹2 Lakh).

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
schemes.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Finance (Department of Financial Services)
schemes.eligibility: Bank / Post office account holders aged 18 to 50 years
schemes.premium: ₹436 per annum (auto-debited from bank account in one installment)
schemes.risk_coverage: Life insurance cover of ₹2 Lakh in case of death due to any cause
schemes.coverage_period: 1st June to 31st May of the subsequent year
schemes.exam_relevance: Very High. Premium ₹436, entry age 18-50, life cover ₹2 Lakh.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
schemes.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Finance (Department of Financial Services)
schemes.eligibility: Bank / Post office account holders aged 18 to 70 years
schemes.risk_coverage: Accidental death or permanent total disability: ₹2 Lakh; Permanent partial disability: ₹1 Lakh
schemes.exam_relevance: Very High. Premium ₹20, age 18-70, accidental cover ₹2 Lakh.

schemes.name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
schemes.eligibility: All Indian citizens aged 18 to 40 years having a savings bank account (Income tax payers not eligible since 1 Oct 2022)
schemes.guaranteed_pension: Fixed monthly pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000, or ₹5,000 after reaching age 60
schemes.death_benefit: Spouse receives same pension; on demise of both, entire accumulated pension corpus returned to nominee
schemes.exam_relevance: Very High. Age 18-40, pension slabs ₹1k-₹5k, PFRDA regulation.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
schemes.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Finance (Department of Financial Services)
schemes.institution: Micro Units Development & Refinance Agency (MUDRA), subsidiary of SIDBI

categories.loan_amount: Loans above ₹50,000 and up to ₹5 Lakh
Loans above ₹5 Lakh and up to ₹10 Lakh
Loans up to ₹20 Lakh (for entrepreneurs who have successfully repaid previous Tarun loans)

schemes.collateral: Collateral-free loans; Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro Units (CGFMU) covers defaults
schemes.exam_relevance: Extremely High. Shishu/Kishore/Tarun/Tarun Plus limits are classic bank exam questions.

schemes.name: Stand-Up India Scheme
schemes.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Finance (Administered by SIDBI & NABARD)
schemes.objective: Facilitate bank loans between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore to at least one SC or ST borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up a greenfield enterprise in manufacturing, services, agri-allied, or trading sector.
schemes.repayment: Repayable in 7 years with maximum moratorium period of 18 months
schemes.exam_relevance: High. ₹10 Lakh to ₹1 Crore loan range, 1 SC/ST + 1 woman per branch.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
schemes.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.financial_benefit: ₹6,000 per year per eligible farmer family
schemes.payment_mode: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) in three equal 4-monthly installments of ₹2,000 each
schemes.funding: 100% Central Sector Scheme fully funded by Government of India
schemes.exam_relevance: Very High. ₹6,000 annual sum, 3 installments of ₹2,000.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
schemes.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.subsidy: Balance actuarial premium paid equally (50:50) by Central and State Governments (90:10 for North Eastern states)
schemes.technology: Crop cutting experiments, Digi-Claim module, YES-TECH, WINDS portal
schemes.exam_relevance: Very High. Kharif 2%, Rabi 1.5%, Commercial 5% premium rates.

schemes.name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
schemes.launch_date: August 1998 (designed by R. V. Gupta Committee)
features: Provides timely short-term credit to farmers for crop cultivation and post-harvest expenses
Extended to animal husbandry, dairy, and fisheries in 2018-19
Credit limit up to ₹3 Lakh at benchmark 7% simple interest
Interest Subvention Scheme (ISS): 1.5% subvention to lending institutions + 3% Prompt Repayment Incentive (PRI) to farmers, resulting in net 4% effective interest rate
schemes.validity: Card valid for 5 years subject to annual review
schemes.exam_relevance: Extremely High. R. V. Gupta committee, ₹3 Lakh limit, net 4% interest with prompt repayment.

schemes.name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
schemes.nodal_ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)
schemes.target: 1 Crore residential households to install rooftop solar units
schemes.benefit: Up to 300 units of free electricity every month
schemes.subsidy_structure: ₹30,000 for 1 kW system; ₹60,000 for 2 kW system; ₹78,000 for 3 kW or larger systems
schemes.financing: Concessional collateral-free bank loans up to ₹2 Lakh at around 7% interest rate through national portal
schemes.exam_relevance: Top Priority Current Scheme. ₹75,021 Cr outlay, 1 Cr households, 300 units free.

schemes.name: PM Vishwakarma Yojana
schemes.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Traditional artisans and craftspeople working with hands and tools across 18 traditional trades (e.g. Carpenter, Blacksmith, Potter, Cobbler, Tailor, Sculptor)
financial_support: Collateral-free enterprise development loan: First tranche up to ₹1,00,000 (18 months repayment); Second tranche up to ₹2,00,000 (30 months repayment)
Concessional interest rate of 5% with interest subvention cap of 8% by Government
Skill training stipend of ₹500/day during basic & advanced training
schemes.exam_relevance: Very High. Outlay ₹13,000 Cr, 18 trades, ₹1L + ₹2L loan tranches at 5% interest.

schemes.name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
schemes.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)
schemes.implementation_partner: Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI)
schemes.target: Urban, peri-urban, and rural street vendors vending before 24 March 2020
schemes.tranches: First Tranche: Collateral-free working capital loan up to ₹10,000 (1 year); Second Tranche: Up to ₹20,000 (on timely repayment); Third Tranche: Up to ₹50,000
schemes.incentive: 7% interest subsidy credited directly to bank account on timely repayment; cashback up to ₹1,200/year on digital transactions
schemes.exam_relevance: High. Loan amounts ₹10k, ₹20k, ₹50k; 7% interest subsidy; SIDBI implementation.

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
schemes.nodal_agency: National Health Authority (NHA), Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
schemes.health_cover: ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary healthcare hospitalization
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Bottom 40% vulnerable families identified based on SECC 2011 data (now expanded to include all senior citizens aged 70+ regardless of income)
schemes.features: Cashless and paperless access at public and empaneled private hospitals nationwide. Covers 3 days pre-hospitalization and 15 days post-hospitalization.
schemes.exam_relevance: Very High. ₹5 Lakh cover, NHA implementation, expansion to all citizens 70+.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
schemes.unit_cost_assistance: ₹1,20,000 in plain areas; ₹1,30,000 in hilly, difficult, and IAP districts
schemes.minimum_size: 25 sq. meters including a dedicated cooking area
schemes.cost_sharing: 60:40 between Centre and States in plain areas; 90:10 for North Eastern and Himalayan States

schemes.name: Jal Jeevan Mission (JJM) - Har Ghar Jal
schemes.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Jal Shakti (Department of Drinking Water and Sanitation)
schemes.objective: Provide Functional Household Tap Connection (FHTC) to every rural household with supply of 55 litres of water per capita per day (lpcd) of prescribed quality on regular basis
schemes.first_certified_state: Goa became India's first 'Har Ghar Jal' certified state; Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu first certified UT; Burhanpur (MP) first certified district
schemes.exam_relevance: High. 55 lpcd water quantity, Goa first certified state, Burhanpur first district.
